title: 10-year rule end date — the off-by-one
catches: tenYearRuleEndDate computed as 10 years from the DATE of death.
notes: December 31 of the 10th calendar year FOLLOWING the year of death. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5(e)(2). Death on/after the RBD also means annual RMDs in years 1-9 IN ADDITION to the year-10 payout - the at-least-as-rapidly rule and the 10-year rule both apply.
